summary: When {person} signs the national closure, the banks in much of the country have already shut under state orders.
realLife: Roosevelt described governors restricting banking before his nationwide order.
gates: State and federal emergency orders cover the same banks.
weights: More states already have orders in effect.
inGame: needs: effective dates and scope of state and national closure orders.

turns.writesBack: The federal order supplies that state's closure date.

turns.what: A state order covers withdrawals alone.
turns.writesBack: The national order changes which transactions remain available.
